main_claim: Paddy Pimblett says he wants to fight Ilia Topuria or Arman Tsarukyan next.
note: Pimblett's own news: 'I'd love to fight him and give him (expletive)' is a callout, so only_mentioned and no_fact. Centrality is unsure because the writer adds 'Topuria, however, does not have a fight booked, so that matchup is very much in play', which could count as weighing his options (one_of_several).

main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight, though nothing is on the schedule yet.
note: White: 'No lo tenemos en la agenda por ahora, pero ... Topuria está listo para pelea' is ready-to-fight and nothing-booked news, with Gaethje and Pimblett named only as options. Fact is unsure because the writer frames it as him being 'recuperado' from the orbital fractures, which an editor could read as health; White himself describes no injury or recovery.

main_claim: After beating Soriano in Paris, Donchenko took the microphone and told the UFC bosses who he wants to fight next.
note: The news is his post-fight wish for an opponent ('прямо заявив босам промоушену, кого прагне побачити'), a wish, so no_fact. The decision win and scorecards are introduced with 'Нагадаємо' as a recap, so result is no, though the scores are given in full; his statement is only described, no words of his are in the saved text (a quote may have been in an embed that was not saved).

main_claim: Paddy Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria at the end of the year and 'crush his head'.
note: Pimblett's callout ('Me encantaría aplastarle la cabeza') is the news; Topuria's eye injuries are recalled with 'cabe recordar' as background. Centrality is unsure because the headline and framing are built around Topuria and the writer adds that he 'no está forzando la máquina y reaparecerá cuando se sienta plenamente preparado', which could be read as something new about him (one_of_several), though no one is named as saying it.

main_claim: After his decision win over Soriano at UFC Paris, Donchenko calls for a fight with Daniel Rodriguez, ideally a five-rounder at the end of the year.
note: Headline and lead are his callout of Rodriguez ('Please, let me fight just with him'), a wish, so no_fact and result no under the statement-after-a-fight rule. Both are unsure because the article also carries a full paragraph retelling the fight round by round and the unanimous decision two days after it, which an editor could treat as a fight report.

main_claim: Topuria released his first statement after losing to Gaethje, praising him, describing vision loss in both eyes during the fight and saying he plans to heal and seek a rematch.
note: The piece is built on his Instagram statement, whose one hard fact is 'vision loss in both eyes during the fight' plus plans to heal, so health; it could be no_fact if that is read as an account of the fight rather than a condition. Result is no as a statement after a fight, though the lead restates the fourth-round TKO loss 'on Sunday'; he_speaks is no because his post is paraphrased ('wrote there were no excuses and that it was Gaethje's night') with no quotation marks, which an editor could count as his words.
